title: Repeated-B outer-frame exchange survey
purpose: Survey the constrained A-only outer-frame operation across every repeated B2 in the fixed-50 five-variable grammar, distinguishing global crossover rules from source-context-preserving swaps.

operation.mirrored_effect: ku1 and ku5 outer frame change together
local_attestation_logic: donor A and donor reverse(B)+reverse(A) outer frame are historically attested in donor
host B+C, C+D, D+E central corridor remains historically attested in host

key_correction.statement: A global B crossover prohibition does not automatically invalidate this operation, because the generated forward B+C remains in the host context and the mirrored outer-frame material comes from the donor context.
key_correction.limit: If B morphology itself must be interpreted consistently across the joined contexts, unresolved or source-dependent B still requires a source-specific review lane. This does not change v0.36 global seam transferability.

groups.conclusion: Best current outer-frame positive family because both spring sources are trusted and B morphology is stable.

reason: Both source poems are mining and semantic review is pending.
The host B+C and donor outer frame can be kept source-local under A-only swap, so global B transferability is not the sole criterion.
However the forward B=また morphology differs or is ambiguous across sources, so no positive promotion is made without source parsing.
groups.global_rule_unchanged: B=また remains non-transferable for general crossover.

groups.reason: All directed swaps cross 夏・鳥 / 秋・紅葉 / 釈教 scenes, so scene gate already holds them before any attempt to relax source-specific B morphology.

representative_results.lesson: sea outer frame versus garden interior creates viewpoint/source-parse tension
broad 月 agreement is insufficient when family/personal outer frame weakens the host scene

groups.conclusion: The きつ group demonstrates that a structurally valid outer-frame operation still needs narrow-scene and semantic-role gates.

next_step: Keep v0.63 as the curated positive generator. Use this survey as the basis for a broader research-only outer-frame enumerator only after operation-specific B source parsing is represented in the common schema.
